value: Fastener, Button, Needle, and Pin Manufacturing

This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing fasteners, buttons, needles, pins, and buckles (except made of precious metals or precious and semiprecious stones and gems).
Buckles and buckle parts (including shoe) manufacturing
Buttons (except precious metal, precious stones, semiprecious stones) manufacturing
Fasteners (e.g., glove, hook and eye, slide, snap) manufacturing
Hook and eye fasteners (i.e., sewing accessories) manufacturing
